title: Kestrel Payments Desk Table — Ticket-Size Card Allowance on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements paid in cash or through an outside lender, card money is measured against the order's card allowance, which stands in for the program's card payment cap: the card room is the card allowance less the card money already on the order, never below zero. The card allowance is built on a basis that follows the ticket size of the order.

**Ticket size.** The ticket size of an order is the vehicle price charged on it net of any reversal of that price.

**Card allowance basis.**

| Ticket size | Card allowance basis |
|---|---|
| $40000.00 or more (the high ticket size) | the larger of the program's card payment cap and 22.5 percent of the ticket size (the high ticket share) |
| $25000.00 or more but below $40000.00 (the middle ticket size up to the high) | the larger of the program's card payment cap and 19.5 percent of the ticket size (the middle ticket share) |
| below $25000.00 | the program's card payment cap |

A ticket share is rounded half up to the cent.

**Program card payment caps.** Kestrel Value Line and Kestrel Inspected $3000.00; Kestrel Certified and Kestrel Certified Plus $5000.00; Kestrel Premium Certified and Kestrel Factory Certified $7500.00.

**Worked examples (hypothetical orders).**

| Program | Ticket size | Share | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | $42000.00 | 22.5 percent: $9450.00 | $9450.00 (above the $3000.00 cap) |
| Kestrel Certified | $25000.00 | 19.5 percent: $4875.00 | $5000.00 (the cap is larger) |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $39999.99 | 19.5 percent: $7799.99805, rounded to $7800.00 | $7800.00 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $40000.00 | 22.5 percent: $9000.00 | $9000.00 |
| Kestrel Inspected | $24999.99 | none | $3000.00 |

A vehicle price that was charged and then reversed counts at its net amount: a $32000.00 price reversed in full and recharged at $30000.00 gives a ticket size of $30000.00.
